transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ____. What brings you in today?
Hi, Dr. ____. I'm here because I feel like I'm always running hot. It's like I can't shut the motor off, you know? And lately, that's been getting me in trouble at the firehouse.
Have you had times when you felt unusually euphoric or overly high?

No, I wouldn't say that. I don't get super high or euphoric or anything like that. I just feel... restless, I guess. Like I have all this energy and nowhere to put it, but I'm not walking around feeling on top of the world or anything. Just wired.
Have you felt this way since childhood?

Yeah, pretty much. My mom says I was exactly like this back in grade school, too. I guess I was always getting out of my seat and blurting out answers in class. I was constantly losing my homework, and she’d get notes sent home from my teachers all the time. It was always kind of the same story—they'd tell her I was bright enough to do the work, I just couldn't sit still or keep track of anything.
Do you still have trouble with attention or getting yourself organized as an adult?

Yeah, I definitely do. I just keep forgetting stuff I honestly mean to get done. Like at the station, I'll forget to sign off on my training modules, or I won't bring the right gear paperwork in on shift. And it's the same outside of work... I'll forget to call people back, or I'll end up paying a bill right after the late fee hits. I really intend to do these things, but they just completely slip my mind.
